instruction: Open the Calendar app. Clear any pop-ups that may appear by granting all permissions that are required.

oracle.command: for p in com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro; do pm path $p >/dev/null 2>&1 && for perm in $(dumpsys package $p | grep -oE 'android.permission.[A-Z_]+: granted=false' | cut -d: -f1); do pm grant $p $perm 2>/dev/null; done; pm path $p >/dev/null 2>&1 && am start -n "$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER $p | tail -1)" && break; done
